decisive_items: A linear, soft-tissue lesion was noted centrally along the lower conjunctival fornix of the right eye; the mass appeared pinkish-yellow rather than the typical salmon pink of lymphoid lesions.
Orbital computed tomography demonstrated a purely conjunctival, homogeneous mass isodense to muscle without infiltration of adjacent structures.
response.rationale: The description of a linear, soft-tissue lesion and a homogeneous mass isodense to muscle on orbital computed tomography supports Conjunctival amyloidosis more than the other options.

rejected.why: The color description of the mass contradicts the typical presentation of Conjunctival lymphoma.
